No province-specific trans-related source was found in this research pass; the national frame applies (see tangential factors), and absence of a documented provincial ban here is not evidence that the province permits LGBTI activity.

sources.summary: Human Rights Watch news release (29 Oct 2025): a leaked omnibus draft (the '11th Judicial Package') would amend the penal and civil codes to criminalise LGBT conduct deemed 'contrary to biological sex and general morality' (up to 3 years), criminalise same-sex ceremonies (up to 4 years), raise the age for gender-affirming healthcare to 25 with mandatory infertility and multiple-evaluation conditions, and punish providers with fines and up to 7 years' imprisonment; 15 LGBT groups and the national medical association object.

Kaos GL (24 Feb 2026) on its LGBTI+ Human Rights Report 2025, 'The Year of the Family: A Major Siege': in 2025 hostility became explicit state policy (presidency-centred; a family ministry as implementing body; religious-authority and broadcasting-regulator restrictions; one LGBTI+ organisation closed); 6 right-to-life violations documented (3 recorded as hate-motivated, trans people most affected), 89 torture/ill-treatment violations (51 the previous year), 313 liberty violations (~2.5x the previous year); official hate-crime statistics are not kept.

NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (only site navigation returned, 414 chars); the underlying item (31 July 2025) covers mass ID checks of trans women in the capital's central district - recorded in the country dossier as a capital-city roundup, not a provincial finding.

tangentialFactors: National-level documented hostility reaches this province as climate rather than provincial evidence: the leaked 11th Judicial Package (HRW, Oct 2025) would criminalise LGBT conduct with prison terms, and 2025 saw hostility institutionalised at state level (Kaos GL: 6 right-to-life violations, 89 torture/ill-treatment cases, 313 liberty violations; no official hate-crime statistics kept), shaping police posture here as it does everywhere in the country.
